description: This file defines a Java interface named ConnectivityQueryCommandResponse, which extends other response and entity-based interfaces for connectivity command responses within the Eclipse Ditto project. It is part of the connectivity query command response handling.

classes.name: ConnectivityQueryCommandResponse
classes.description: A generic interface representing responses to connectivity query commands, allowing setting Ditto headers and providing entity information.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Sets the Ditto headers for the response, returning the response object for chaining.
